comments.body: I've always collected at the Lone Cedar. From the Gate head right till you see the White Flowers on your left. From there you'll see the Lone Cedar on your right

comments.author: Mecha
comments.body:
i found that the large boulder in the northeastern area is a better spot for collecting flax

on abg at the lone cedar id get about 90 flax and 200+ logs

but at the boulder on avg i get about 120 flax and 200+ logs
mainly seem to get less common grass there then at the lone cedar
